server.name: codeximmortal
server.display_name: Codex Immortal — Enterprise Agentic AI Platform
server.description: Governed agentic AI for operations, security, and revenue. Browse the product catalog, verify cryptographic attestations, request threat-hunt scans, and initiate purchases — every action metered and audit-logged.

auth.note: No purchase scope is granted at registration. Purchase requires a separately approved AP2/x402 authorization (see governance.purchase).

tools.name: codex_catalog_list
tools.description: List Codex Immortal products and services with pricing basis, capabilities, denied capabilities, and validation status.

tools.name: codex_catalog_get_product
tools.description: Get the full ERC-8004-shaped service offer for one product: capabilities, pricing, SLA, refund/dispute terms, evidence and validation status.

tools.name: codex_quote_request
tools.description: Request a quote for volume, enterprise, or custom-scope engagements. Returns an RFQ reference and expected response time.

tools.name: codex_attestation_verify
tools.description: Verify a Codex Immortal attestation record: content hash, signature, timestamp, and ledger inclusion proof.

attestation_id.description: Attestation ID or sha256 content hash

tools.name: codex_scan_request
tools.description: Request an autonomous threat-hunt scan (supply-chain, insider-threat, HNDL triage). Defensive and read-only by design. Live-scope scans route to human gate before execution.

tools.name: codex_purchase_initiate
tools.description: Prepare a purchase proposal for a catalog item. Returns an AP2/x402 checkout payload draft for human approval. This tool never executes a payment, charges a card, or moves funds — execution happens only through the isolated financial connector gateway after a valid, exact-match, single-use TGA is issued.

governance.ingress: All tool calls route through the CI-059 A2A-GATEWAY genetic ML firewall; adversarial payloads are blocked and logged (JSON-RPC error -32004).
governance.metering: Every call is wallet-metered; insufficient balance returns -32003 and is logged for cost accounting.
governance.human_gate: Tasks tagged BIO, SPACE, KINETIC, OT_ICS, or TOP_SECRET transition to the human-gate task state and do not execute autonomously.

purchase.doctrine: ERC-8004 / TGA: agents propose; humans approve exact financial consequences; isolated gateways execute one matching authorization; settlement reconciliation determines verified value.

governance.audit: Every tool call emits an immutable audit event (content hash, signature, timestamp) to the attestation ledger; result payloads are tagged with their context mode (RAG/CAG/HAG).
governance.secrets_policy: No raw API keys, wallet keys, customer PII, or approval secrets ever appear in tool schemas, responses, logs, or manifests.
